text:
anita: quick q — when we show SLO alert rules in console, how do we map backend routing policies to the edit UI? i'm worried the current API shape leaks too many knobs

devin: short answer: surface a small subset (notify targets, severity, quiet window) and keep advanced routing under 'advanced' accordion. API currently returns `route_policy` + `escalation_policies`.

devin: here's current proto shape we get from platform API:
```
{
  "id": "...",
  "threshold_pct": 95,
  "window_minutes": 30,
  "route_policy": "per-tenant|global|fallback",
  "notify_channels": ["pagerduty", "slack"],
  "sample_rate": 0.02,
  "suppress_until": null
}
```

sam: fwiw SRE prefers we don't expose `sample_rate` by default — it confuses owners. also aggregation window changes change burn calculations.

maria: UX question — if we hide advanced fields, how will users preview the effective routing? can we show a read-only 'effective routing' card that resolves tenant->channel?

devin: yes, we can add a preview call: GET /console/preview-routing?rule_id=... returns resolved list. we already compute that in the policy engine.

elliot: product asks for rollout path: default rules change needs both console migration and platform migration. propose staged rollout: (1) console opt-in, (2) platform default toggle + telemetry, (3) enforce after 2 weeks.

anita: sounds good. can we also emit telemetry for 'console_preview_used' and 'edit_advanced_opened' events? want metrics to detect confusion/noise

devin: agreed. i'll add two events and a flag `ui_preview_v1` in the rule metadata so we can tie back to rules created via preview flow.

deploy-bot: deployment succeeded for branch platform/route-preview (build #412)

sam: Also add an alert if >10% of edits flip `route_policy` to fallback within 24h — indicates we might be overfitting defaults :thinking_face:

maria: noted — i'll add a small CTA in the editor explaining when to use 'fallback' and link to runbook.

anita: awesome. next step: devin can you drop the API snippet in the PR and add the telemetry events as part of the migration ticket? tagging @devin

devin: on it, i'll open PR and link the migration ticket before EOD. :thumbsup:
